lessonTitle: 47. The distance formula; the equation of a sphere
lessonTitleEnglish: The distance formula; the equation of a sphere
unit: Geometry · Chapter 6. Coordinates and vectors in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The distance between A(x₁; y₁; z₁) and B(x₂; y₂; z₂) is AB = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²).
stages.headlineEnglish: The distance between A(x₁; y₁; z₁) and B(x₂; y₂; z₂) is AB = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²).

stages.headline: The sphere with centre C(a; b; c) and radius R: (x − a)² + (y − b)² + (z − c)² = R².
stages.headlineEnglish: The sphere with centre C(a; b; c) and radius R: (x − a)² + (y − b)² + (z − c)² = R².

stages.headline: Example: (x − 1)² + y² + (z + 2)² = 9 has centre (1; 0; −2) and radius 3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: (x − 1)² + y² + (z + 2)² = 9 has centre (1; 0; −2) and radius 3.
